name: Adenosine Monophosphate Deaminase Deficiency

criteria.description: Reduced or absent AMP deaminase enzyme activity in skeletal muscle biopsy
Identification of pathogenic variants in the AMPD1 gene
Exercise-induced muscle cramps, myalgia, and fatigue

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of reduced AMP deaminase enzyme activity in muscle biopsy plus identification of pathogenic AMPD1 variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be supported by clinical presentation and exclusion of other metabolic myopathies.

laboratory: Reduced AMP deaminase enzyme activity in skeletal muscle biopsy
imaging: Muscle MRI may show nonspecific changes such as mild edema or fatty infiltration
other: Histochemical staining of muscle biopsy showing absent or reduced myoadenylate deaminase activity

distinguishingFeatures: More severe exercise intolerance with second-wind phenomenon
Ragged red fibers on muscle biopsy

redFlags: Severe rhabdomyolysis with acute kidney injury
Progressive muscle weakness beyond exertional symptoms
references: Fishbein WN. Adenosine monophosphate deaminase deficiency and muscle disease. Muscle Nerve. 1993;16(11):1177-1185.
Kornblum C, et al. AMP deaminase deficiency: clinical and biochemical features. Neurology. 2002;59(3):420-423.
